title: touchmark status and apply report
description: The JSON report of touchmark status and touchmark apply (status/v1): one target's working tree against the hub, one entry per managed path, and for apply what it did with each change.

dry_run.description: apply --dry-run: the plan only, nothing written. Always false for status.

ref.description: The target in targets.yml, path or provider:path; empty when it could not be determined.

opt_in_file.description: The opt-in file's path in the target.

opted_in.description: The target gets packs: opt_in is file, assumed or flag.

opt_in.description: Why the target is opted in or not. file: the opt-in file is there; assumed: there is none, and a repo: entry with opt_in: assumed subscribes it; flag: there is none, and --assume-opt-in counts it as opted in; opted-out: the file says enabled: false; none: neither.

selection.description: The resolved pack list; null when the target has not opted in.

packs.description: The packs the target gets, requires included.

complete.description: Every pack named was found in the hub.

unresolved.description: Packs named that the hub does not have.

sources.description: Per pack, where it was selected: the opt-in file, targets.yml, defaults or requires <pack>.

entries.description: The whole plan in plan order, one entry per managed path, current entries included.

state.description: The file's state in the target.

pack.description: The pack that ships the path, or shipped it.

from.description: The blob id the target has; empty when it has none.

to.description: The blob id apply writes; empty for keep and delete.

mode.description: The file mode apply writes; empty when it writes nothing.

detail.description: Why, for states and actions that need a reason.

after_deletes.description: Written after the deletes, because a path it needs is deleted first.

results.description: apply without --dry-run only: what it did with each entry whose action is not keep, in execution order.

detail.description: The reason for skipped and the error for failed.

summary.description: Entries per state, the changes (entries whose action is not keep) and, for apply, the outcomes.

hub.description: The hub the report was made from.

id.description: hub.yml's id; empty for a hub without hub.yml.

commit.description: The hub commit read; empty when touchmark stopped before reading it.
